summary: CID Holdco, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 10, 2026, announcing that after a strategic review it entered two non-binding letters of intent: a convertible preferred stock investment of up to $5.0 million and a sale of a portion of its operating business for about $6.0 million in cash plus assumption of up to $3.0 million in liabilities. The investor may also provide additional funding for value-creating initiatives. No board recommendation or advisors are named. The transactions remain non-binding and subject to definitive agreements, stockholder, lender, Nasdaq, and regulatory approvals. Watch for definitive agreement execution and risk of deal failure.
